Title: Butter-Fried Ribeye Steak
Ingredients: 1 ribeye steak (about 10.5 oz/300 g); 1 tbsp butter; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat a skillet on high heat and melt the butter. Season the ribeye with salt. Sear the steak for 3–4 minutes on each side for medium-rare (cook longer if you prefer it more done). Baste with the melted butter during the last 2 minutes:. Remove from heat and let the steak rest for 5 minutes. Slice and serve, adding salt to taste.

Title: Ground Beef and Egg Scramble
Ingredients: 7 oz (200 g) ground beef (80/20); 2 eggs; 1 tbsp beef tallow or butter
Instructions: Heat tallow in a skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned:. Crack in the eggs and scramble everything together until the eggs are just set:. Season with salt to taste and serve hot.

Title: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs
Ingredients: 2 bone-in chicken thighs with skin; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Pat chicken thighs dry and season all over with salt. Place thighs in the air fryer basket, skin side up, and cook for ~20 minutes:, flipping halfway through for even crispiness:. Cook until skin is golden and chicken is cooked through. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

Title: Pan-Fried Pork Belly
Ingredients: 5.3 oz (150 g) pork belly slices; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Slice pork belly into thin strips (if not pre-sliced). Lightly season the pork belly slices with salt:. Place the slices in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides:. Transfer to a plate and serve immediately.

Title: Beef Liver and Egg Combo
Ingredients: 3.5 oz (100 g) beef liver; 2 eggs; 2 tbsp butter
Instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add beef liver slices and sear ~2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned (do not overcook). Remove liver and set aside. In the same pan, fry the eggs to your desired doneness:. Serve the eggs alongside the liver; season with salt and enjoy together:.

Title: Carnivore Cheesy Omelet
Ingredients: 3 eggs; 1 oz (30 g) cheddar cheese, shredded; 1 tbsp butter
Instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour in the eggs. As the omelet sets, sprinkle cheese over one half:. Fold the omelet and cook 1 more minute until cheese melts. Slide onto a plate and serve hot:.

Title: Tuna and Egg Mash (Cold Meal)
Ingredients: 1 can tuna (drained); 2 hard-boiled eggs; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: In a bowl, combine the drained tuna and peeled hard-boiled eggs. Mash them together thoroughly with a fork: until well combined. Season with salt to taste and serve. *No cooking is required beyond boiling the eggs in advance.*

Title: Carnivore Meatballs
Ingredients: 10.5 oz (300 g) ground beef; 1 egg; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a bowl, mix ground beef with the egg and salt. Form the mixture into meatballs ~1–1½ inches in diameter:. Place on a baking sheet and bake ~15 minutes, until cooked through:. (Alternatively, pan-fry meatballs in a skillet until browned and done.)

Title: Crispy Duck Breast
Ingredients: 1 duck breast (7 oz/200 g); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Score the duck skin in a crosshatch pattern (without cutting the meat). Season both sides with salt:. Place duck breast skin-side down in a *cold* skillet, then heat to medium. Cook ~7 minutes to render fat and crisp the skin. Flip and cook ~4 more minutes, or until desired doneness:. Let rest a few minutes, then slice and serve.

Title: Beef Bone Marrow with Salt
Ingredients: 2 beef marrow bones (~7 oz/200 g total); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Stand the marrow bones upright on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and roast ~15 minutes:, until the marrow is soft and bubbling. Remove and let cool slightly. Scoop out the warm marrow, sprinkle with additional salt, and enjoy (spread it on meat or eat with a spoon).

Title: Egg and Bacon Muffins
Ingredients: 3 eggs; 3 strips bacon
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line 3 muffin cups with bacon (around the sides). Crack an egg into each bacon-lined cup:. Bake ~20 minutes until the egg is set and bacon is crisp:. Let cool 5 minutes, then remove from the muffin tin and serve.

Title: Ground Beef Bowl with Egg Yolk
Ingredients: 7 oz (200 g) ground beef (80/20); 2 egg yolks; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned and fully cooked, breaking it up as it cooks:. Transfer beef to a bowl. Let cool 1 minute, then top with the raw egg yolks. Stir the yolks into the hot beef, letting them coat and slightly cook:. Season with salt and enjoy.

Title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Crispy Skin
Ingredients: 7 oz (200 g) salmon fillet, skin-on; 1 tsp ghee (or butter); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Pat salmon dry and season with salt. Heat ghee in a skillet over medium-high heat. When hot, place salmon skin-side down and sear ~5 minutes until skin is crisp:. Flip and cook ~2 more minutes until cooked to your liking:. Remove from heat and serve (optionally with pan juices).

Title: Tuna Steak with Bone Marrow Butter
Ingredients: 5 oz (150 g) tuna steak; 1 tbsp bone marrow (melted); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Season tuna steak with salt:. Heat a skillet on high. Sear tuna ~1–2 minutes per side (for medium-rare):. Separately, melt the bone marrow (in a small pan or microwave) until liquid. Place tuna on a plate and pour the melted marrow over it:. Serve immediately.

Title: Sardines in Goat Butter
Ingredients: 1 can sardines (in water, drained); 1 tbsp goat butter (or butter)
Instructions: Place a small skillet over medium heat. Add drained sardines and butter. Warm and fry gently ~1–2 minutes until heated through:. Transfer to a plate and spoon any melted butter over top. Serve warm.

Title: Duck Leg with Crispy Skin
Ingredients: 1 duck leg (7 oz/200 g); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Pat duck leg dry and rub with salt:. Place leg skin-side up in a roasting pan. Roast ~40–45 minutes until skin is crisp and duck is cooked through:. Rest a few minutes before serving.

Title: Latin-Style Carnitas (Shredded Pork)
Ingredients: 3.3 lbs (1.5 kg) pork shoulder; 8.8 oz (250 g) pork lard; 2 tsp sea salt
Instructions: Cut pork into large chunks. Place in a slow cooker with lard and salt:. Cook on low ~6 hours until pork is fall-apart tender:. Shred the meat. Spread shredded pork on a baking tray and broil ~5 minutes until crispy edges develop:. Serve hot (with some rendered lard mixed in for moisture).

Title: Asian-Inspired Duck Breast with Bone Broth
Ingredients: 2 duck breasts (7 oz/200 g each); 2 tbsp beef tallow; 2 cups beef bone broth; 1 slice fresh ginger (optional); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Score the duck breast skins. Place breasts skin-side down in a cold pan and cook ~7 minutes to render fat:. Flip and cook ~4 more minutes to finish cooking the duck:. Meanwhile, in a pot combine bone broth, ginger, and tallow; simmer until hot:. Slice the duck and serve in bowls, pouring the hot bone broth (with ginger removed for strict carnivore) over the duck.

Title: Rustic Osso Buco (Beef Shank)
Ingredients: 2.6 lbs (1.2 kg) beef shank; 1 liter beef bone broth; 3 tbsp beef tallow; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Heat tallow in a Dutch oven. Sear shank pieces ~3 minutes per side until browned:. Add bone broth and salt; bring to a boil and scrape up browned bits:. Cover and transfer to oven (or lower heat to simmer on stovetop). Cook ~3 hours until meat is very tender:. Serve the shank with the rich broth spooned over.

Title: Crispy Chicken Skin Chips
Ingredients: 14 oz (400 g) chicken skin; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 356°F (180°C). Lay chicken skins flat on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt:. Bake ~20 minutes until skins are browned and crispy:. Cool on paper towels to crisp further. Enjoy these crunchy chicken skin chips once cooled.

Title: Salmon with Butter Sauce
Ingredients: 2 salmon fillets (7 oz/200 g each); 3 tbsp butter; 1 tsp salt; (optional: 1 tsp lemon juice for non-strict)
Instructions: Season salmon with salt. In a skillet over medium-high heat, melt 1 tbsp butter. Sear salmon skin-side down ~5 minutes until skin crisps:. Flip and cook ~3 more minutes:. Separately, melt remaining butter (stir in lemon juice off-heat if using). Plate salmon and pour butter sauce over top. (Omit lemon for strict carnivore.)

Title: Ribeye Steak with Garlic Butter Baste
Ingredients: 10.5 oz (300 g) ribeye steak; 2 tbsp butter; 1 clove garlic (smashed); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Season steak with salt. Heat a skillet on high and melt 1 tbsp butter. Sear steak ~3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare:. Add remaining butter and garlic to pan; tilt pan and spoon hot garlic butter over steak for ~2 minutes:. Rest 5 minutes before serving, drizzled with garlic butter.

Title: Beef Liver Pâté
Ingredients: 10.5 oz (300 g) beef liver; 3.5 tbsp (50 g) butter; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add liver and sauté ~3–4 minutes until just cooked (slightly pink inside):. Transfer liver and butter to a food processor, add salt, and blend until smooth:. Chill until firm. Serve cold as a rich, meaty spread.

Title: Slow-Cooked Beef Short Ribs
Ingredients: 2.6 lbs (1.2 kg) beef short ribs; 2 cups beef bone broth; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Season ribs with salt. Place in a slow cooker, pour in bone broth:, and cook on LOW ~6 hours until meat is very tender:. (Alternatively, simmer covered on stovetop for ~3 hours.) Optionally broil 5 minutes for a browned finish:. Serve with some cooking juices spooned over.

Title: Pan-Seared Lamb Chops
Ingredients: 4 lamb chops (5 oz/150 g each); 2 tbsp ghee (or lamb fat); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat ghee in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season lamb chops with salt. Sear chops ~3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked to desired doneness:. Let rest ~3 minutes before serving:.

Title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
Ingredients: 7 oz (200 g) smoked salmon; 2 oz (60 g) cream cheese; 1 tsp capers (optional)
Instructions: Lay out salmon slices. Spread each with cream cheese. Sprinkle capers (if using). Roll up each slice tightly:. Serve immediately. (For strict carnivore, omit capers and ensure cream cheese has no carbs.)

Title: Pork Belly Burnt Ends
Ingredients: 2.6 lbs (1.2 kg) pork belly; 3 tbsp pork lard; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Cut pork belly into 1-inch cubes:. Toss cubes with melted lard and salt:. Spread on a baking tray and bake ~3 hours until tender:. For caramelized edges, broil briefly at end:. Serve hot.

Title: Scrambled Eggs with Bone Marrow
Ingredients: 3 eggs; 1.4 oz (40 g) roasted bone marrow; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Melt the bone marrow in a skillet over medium heat. In a bowl, beat eggs with salt. Pour eggs into the hot marrow fat and scramble gently until just set:. Serve immediately – the melted marrow enriches the creamy scrambled eggs.

Title: Pan-Fried Cod in Ghee
Ingredients: 2 cod fillets (7 oz/200 g each); 3 tbsp ghee; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat ghee in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season cod with salt:. Fry fillets ~3–4 minutes per side until golden and fish flakes easily:. Serve hot, drizzled with the browned ghee from the pan.

Title: Venison Stew
Ingredients: 2.2 lbs (1 kg) venison, cubed; 3 tbsp beef tallow; 1 liter beef bone broth; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Brown the venison in tallow over medium-high heat (in batches if needed):. Add bone broth and salt, bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cover and simmer ~2 hours, stirring occasionally, until venison is tender:. (Add water if needed.) Serve hot with the broth.

Title: Salmon with Carnivore Hollandaise Sauce
Ingredients: 2 salmon fillets (7 oz/200 g each); 3 egg yolks; 3.5 oz (100 g) butter; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 356°F (180°C). Bake salmon fillets ~12–15 minutes until cooked through:. Meanwhile, make hollandaise: melt butter; whisk egg yolks in a pan over very low heat, then slowly stream in melted butter while whisking until thickened, then add salt:. Serve salmon topped with the warm hollandaise. (All animal-based ingredients – strict carnivore friendly.)

Title: Carnivore Surf and Turf (Steak and Shrimp)
Ingredients: 1 steak (ribeye or sirloin, ~10 oz); 8 oz large shrimp, peeled; 2 tbsp butter (divided); salt to taste
Instructions: Let steak sit at room temp ~30 mins. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tbsp butter. Sear steak ~3–4 mins per side (for medium-rare) and baste with butter; season with salt and set aside to rest:. In same pan add 1 tbsp butter; when melted, add shrimp and cook ~1–2 mins per side until pink:. Season shrimp with salt. Serve steak with shrimp and drizzle pan juices over top:.

Title: Baked Carnivore Omelet Roll with Ham and Cheese
Ingredients: 8 eggs; 8 oz cream cheese; 1 tbsp gelatin powder; 1 cup grated Parmesan; 1 cup diced ham
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a bowl, beat eggs and cream cheese until smooth. Gradually mix in gelatin to avoid lumps:. Pour into a greased 10x14-inch pan. Bake ~15 minutes until just set (do not overbake):. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle cheese and ham evenly over the omelet:. Starting from a short end, roll the omelet tightly while hot. Let rest seam-side down. Slice and serve (great for breakfast or dinner).

Title: Carnivore Cheeseburger Pie
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef; 3 eggs; 3 tbsp water; 2 cups shredded cheese; 1 tsp salt; (butter for frying)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a skillet, brown the ground beef in butter, crumbling as it cooks. Spread cooked beef in a 9-inch pie dish:. In a bowl, whisk eggs, water, cheese, and salt. Pour over beef in pie dish:. Bake ~25 minutes until cheese is melted and golden and center is set:. Let cool 10 minutes, then slice and serve. (Crustless, all meat and cheese pie.)

Title: Carnivore Butter Bacon Chicken
Ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves; 8 bacon slices; 4 tbsp butter; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Season chicken with salt:. Wrap each breast with 2 bacon slices (in an X pattern): and place in a baking dish. Top each with pieces of butter:. Bake 30–40 minutes until chicken is cooked through (165°F) and bacon is crispy:. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the buttery pan drippings spooned over top.

Title: Brown Butter Bites
Ingredients: 2 sticks butter (8 oz total)
Instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Continue heating; butter will foam. Stir and watch carefully as milk solids brown (become golden with a nutty aroma):. When desired brownness is reached, remove from heat (takes ~5 minutes). Cool ~5 minutes:. Pour browned butter (including brown specks) into silicone molds or a parchment-lined dish. Freeze until solid:. Pop out the frozen “butter bites” and store in fridge/freezer. These high-fat bites make a rich snack.

Title: 2-Ingredient Carnivore Pancakes
Ingredients: 4 oz cream cheese; 4 eggs; (butter for frying)
Instructions: Blend eggs and cream cheese until smooth. Heat a buttered skillet over medium heat. Pour batter to form small pancakes. Cook ~2 minutes, then flip and cook 2–3 more minutes until golden:. Repeat with remaining batter:. Serve warm, optionally topped with more butter.

Title: Zero-Carb Chocolate Mug Cake
Ingredients: 1 egg; 1 tbsp heavy whipping cream; 1/2 tbsp butter; 1 tsp collagen powder; 1 tbsp ground coffee
Instructions: Mix collagen and coffee powder together:. In a microwave-safe mug, melt butter (~15 seconds). In a bowl, whisk egg and cream. Swirl melted butter around mug to grease it, then pour remaining butter into egg mixture and mix. Stir in collagen+coffee to form a batter:. Pour batter into mug. Microwave ~1 minute until set. Let cool slightly and enjoy straight from the mug.

Title: Carnivore Egg Pudding Dessert
Ingredients: 5 eggs; 4 oz half-and-half (or whole milk); 1 tbsp butter; (optional: 2.5 tbsp zero-carb sweetener, 1 tsp vanilla); pinch of salt
Instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, whisk together eggs, half-and-half, and butter (add sweetener & vanilla if using). Stir constantly until mixture thickens and coats the spoon (forming a custard). Do not boil. Remove from heat, stir in salt, and pour into ramekins. Chill for at least 2 hours until set. Enjoy this silky custard cold. *(Omit sweetener/vanilla for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Creamy Carnivore Cheesecake
Ingredients: 3.8 oz cream cheese; 1/4 cup heavy cream; 3 eggs; 1/2 tsp sea salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (for a gentle bake) or prepare a water bath. Blend cream cheese, heavy cream, eggs, and salt until smooth. Pour into a small baking dish (or several ramekins). Bake at 300°F for ~20 minutes (or cook in a simmering water bath) until the custard is barely set in center. Cool, then chill in fridge until firm. Serve cold. *(Crustless cheesecake; all animal-based ingredients.)*

Title: Carnivore Custard Pie
Ingredients: 3 eggs; 2 cups heavy cream; 1 tbsp vanilla (optional); pinch of salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Whisk eggs, heavy cream, and salt (and vanilla if using) until well combined. Pour into a pie dish. Set the dish in a larger pan with ~1 inch of hot water (water bath). Bake ~30 minutes until custard is set at edges but still slightly jiggly in center. Remove from oven and water bath. Cool, then chill. Slice and serve cold. *(Omit vanilla for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Sugar-Free Carnivore Ice Cream
Ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream; 1/4 tsp vanilla (optional); 2 tbsp erythritol sweetener (optional)
Instructions: In a chilled bowl, whip heavy cream (with vanilla and sweetener if using) to soft peaks. For a soft “ice cream,” enjoy immediately as whipped cream. For a firmer ice cream, transfer to a container and freeze ~2–3 hours, stirring every 30 minutes for an even texture. Serve semi-frozen for a creamy, scoopable carnivore ice cream. *(For strict carnivore, omit vanilla and sweetener.)*

Title: Homemade Pemmican Bars
Ingredients: 8 oz dried lean beef (jerky); 8 oz beef tallow (melted); (optional: dried liver powder)
Instructions: Grind the dried beef (and dried liver, if using) into a coarse powder. In a bowl, combine the powdered meat with melted tallow and mix thoroughly until it forms a thick paste. Spread this mixture into a pan or mold and let it cool/harden (refrigerate to set). Once solid, cut into bars. Store in a cool, dry place. Pemmican is a classic zero-carb high-energy snack made of dried meat and fat:, perfect for carnivore diets.

Title: Homemade Beef Jerky
Ingredients: 1.5 lbs lean beef (e.g. top round); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Slice beef into thin strips (~1/4 inch). Season with salt (you may marinate strips in saltwater overnight for better penetration). Arrange strips on dehydrator trays (or on a wire rack in a 150°F oven). Dry for ~4–6 hours until meat is dry and chewy. Let cool and store in an airtight container. **Homemade jerky contains no carbs and is nearly pure protein, an ideal carnivore snack.**

Title: Bone Broth
Ingredients: 2–3 lbs animal bones (beef knuckles, marrow bones, etc.); 1 gallon water; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Place bones in a large pot, add water to cover, and add salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a very low simmer. Simmer for ~12–24 hours, skimming foam as needed:. (Alternatively, use a slow cooker on LOW.) Strain out bones. Optionally, chill and remove hardened fat from the top. Reheat to serve. Sip the broth hot, seasoned with additional salt. Rich in collagen and minerals, bone broth is a nourishing carnivore snack.

Title: Parmesan Crisps
Ingredients: 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment. Spoon tablespoon-sized mounds of shredded Parmesan onto the sheet, a few inches apart. Lightly flatten each mound. Bake ~6–8 minutes until cheese has melted and turns golden brown. Let cool on the sheet until crisp, then peel off. These crispy cheese chips are all dairy (no carbs) and satisfy crunchy snack cravings.

Title: Hard-Boiled Eggs
Ingredients: 2 eggs; salt to taste
Instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a rolling boil, then turn off heat, cover, and let sit ~8–10 minutes. Drain and transfer eggs to cold water to cool. Peel the eggs and sprinkle with salt to taste. Enjoy as a quick, portable carnivore snack:. *(Each large hard-boiled egg ~5 g fat, 6 g protein.)*

Title: Smoked Beef Brisket
Ingredients: 4 lbs (1.8 kg) beef brisket; 2 tbsp coarse salt
Instructions: Preheat a smoker to 225°F (107°C). Season the brisket generously with salt on all sides:. Place brisket in smoker fat-side up and smoke ~8–10 hours until fork-tender and a dark bark forms (internal temp ~203°F):. Remove from smoker and let rest at least 30 minutes before slicing against the grain. Serve hot, with melted fat drizzled on top.

Title: Bacon-Wrapped Filet Mignon
Ingredients: 2 beef filet mignon steaks (~6 oz each); 2 slices bacon; 2 tsp salt; 1 tbsp butter (for finishing)
Instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Wrap each filet mignon around the edge with a strip of bacon, securing with a toothpick:. Season steaks with salt. Grill filets ~5–6 minutes per side for medium-rare (bacon will crisp up):. Remove from grill and top each with butter while resting ~5 minutes. Remove toothpicks and serve.

Title: Grilled Beef Heart
Ingredients: 1 beef heart (about 1.5 lbs/680 g); 2 tbsp beef tallow (melted); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Trim fat and connective tissue from the beef heart and slice into 1/2-inch steaks. Marinate heart slices in melted tallow and salt for 10 minutes:. Preheat grill to high heat. Grill heart steaks ~4–5 minutes per side until browned but still tender:. Let rest a few minutes, then slice against the grain. Serve immediately, seasoned with additional salt if needed.

Title: Slow-Cooked Beef Tongue
Ingredients: 1 beef tongue (~2.5 lbs/1.1 kg); water to cover; 2 tbsp salt
Instructions: Rinse the beef tongue and place in a slow cooker. Add enough water to cover and add salt:. Cook on LOW ~8 hours until tongue is very tender. Remove tongue and let cool slightly. Peel off the thick outer membrane:. Slice the tongue thinly. Serve warm, with a sprinkle of salt and some cooking broth on the side as au jus.

Title: Oxtail Stew
Ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) oxtails; 4 cups beef bone broth; 3 tbsp tallow; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C) or set a slow cooker on LOW. In a heavy pot or Dutch oven, heat tallow over medium-high heat and sear oxtails until browned on all sides:. Add bone broth and salt; bring to a simmer and scrape up any browned bits:. Cover and slow-cook in oven or slow cooker ~3 hours until oxtails are fall-apart tender:. Skim excess fat, if desired. Serve hot, with tender oxtail meat and rich broth in each bowl.

Title: Bacon-Topped Carnivore Meatloaf
Ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef (80/20); 2 eggs; 1 cup crushed pork rinds; 1 tsp salt; 4–5 slices bacon
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a bowl, combine ground beef, eggs, crushed pork rinds, and salt. Mix well and form into a loaf shape in a baking dish:. Lay bacon slices over the top of the loaf, covering it completely (stretch or overlap as needed):. Bake ~40–50 minutes until meatloaf is cooked through (160°F center) and bacon is crisp on top:. Let rest 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm.

Title: Steak Tartare
Ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) raw beef tenderloin (or lean steak); 1 egg yolk; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Finely mince the raw beef with a sharp knife. In a bowl, gently combine the minced beef with salt:. Mound the beef on a serving plate and make a small well on top. Carefully place the raw egg yolk in the well:. To eat, mix the yolk into the beef. Serve immediately, keeping the dish cold. *(Consuming raw meat and egg is for advanced carnivore adherents.)*

Title: Bacon Deviled Eggs
Ingredients: 4 eggs; 2 slices bacon; 2 tbsp softened butter; 1/2 tsp salt
Instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Turn off heat, cover, and let sit ~9 minutes. Cool eggs in cold water, then peel:. Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp; crumble and set aside. Halve the boiled eggs and scoop out yolks. Mash yolks with butter and salt until smooth:. Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture back into egg whites. Top with crumbled bacon and serve.

Title: Bacon-Wrapped Scallops
Ingredients: 8 large sea scallops (about 1 lb total); 8 bacon slices; 1 tsp salt; 2 tbsp melted butter (for basting)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat scallops dry and lightly season with salt. Wrap each scallop in a half slice of bacon (cut bacon strips in half) and secure with a toothpick:. Place bacon-wrapped scallops on a baking sheet. Brush with melted butter:. Bake ~12–15 minutes, flipping once, until bacon is crispy and scallops are cooked through (opaque):. Remove toothpicks and serve hot.

Title: Grilled Garlic Butter Shrimp Skewers
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined; 4 tbsp butter (melted); 3 cloves garlic (minced); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high. In a bowl, toss shrimp with melted butter, garlic, and salt:. Thread shrimp onto skewers (if using wooden skewers, soak in water first). Grill shrimp ~2–3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through:. Baste once with remaining garlic butter while grilling:. Remove from grill and serve hot, drizzling any extra garlic butter over top. *(Omit garlic for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Crispy Baked Liver Chips
Ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) beef liver; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 170°F (75°C) or use a food dehydrator. Pat liver dry and slice as thinly as possible (1/8 inch or less). Arrange slices on a parchment-lined baking sheet without overlapping:. Sprinkle with salt. Dry in the oven or dehydrator ~4–6 hours until the liver slices are completely dry and crispy:. Let chips cool to room temperature (they will crisp further as they cool). Store in an airtight container and enjoy as a crunchy carnivore snack.

Title: Cheese-Stuffed Bacon Burger Patties
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef (85/15); 4 oz (115 g) cheddar cheese, cut into 4 cubes; 4 slices bacon; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Divide ground beef into four equal portions. Form each into a flat patty and press a cube of cheese into the center, wrapping the meat around it to seal:. Season the patties with salt. In a skillet over medium-high heat, fry bacon until crisp; remove and set aside. In the same skillet, cook burger patties ~3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, with cheese melted inside:. Top each patty with a bacon strip (or crumble bacon over top) and serve hot.

Title: Slow-Cooked Lamb Shoulder
Ingredients: 1 lamb shoulder roast (~4 lbs/1.8 kg); 2 tbsp tallow or butter; 2 tsp salt; (optional: 4 cloves garlic, rosemary sprigs)
Instructions: Season lamb shoulder all over with salt. If using, make small slits in the meat and insert garlic slivers and rosemary:. Place lamb in a slow cooker with tallow. Cook on LOW ~6 hours (or in a 275°F/135°C oven for ~5 hours) until meat is extremely tender:. For a crisp finish, broil the lamb in the oven for a few minutes to brown the exterior:. Let rest 10 minutes before shredding or slicing. *(Remove garlic and herbs for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Crispy Tallow-Fried Chicken Wings
Ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) chicken wings (split into flats and drumettes); beef tallow or lard for deep frying; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat tallow in a deep fryer or heavy pot to 350°F (175°C). Pat chicken wings dry and season with salt:. Fry wings in batches, 8–10 minutes, until golden brown and crispy:. Remove and let excess fat drain on a rack or paper towels. Serve hot; you can toss wings in melted butter or extra salt to taste after frying.

Title: Pork Rind Fried Chicken Tenders
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) chicken breast tenders; 2 eggs; 2 cups crushed pork rinds; beef tallow (for frying); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat tallow in a deep pan or fryer to 350°F (175°C). Beat the eggs in a bowl. Place crushed pork rinds in a separate bowl. Season chicken tenders with salt, then dip each in egg, then roll in pork rind crumbs to coat:. Fry breaded tenders in hot tallow ~3–4 minutes per side (or ~5–6 minutes total) until golden brown and cooked through:. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot with optional melted butter as a dipping sauce.

Title: Egg Drop Bone Broth Soup
Ingredients: 2 cups hot beef bone broth; 2 eggs; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Pour hot beef bone broth into a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer:. In a bowl, beat the eggs with salt. Slowly pour the beaten eggs into the simmering broth while stirring in one direction:. The eggs will cook into thin ribbons (egg drop). Turn off heat. Serve immediately, sipping the savory broth and tender cooked egg.

Title: Bacon-Infused Chicken Liver Pâté
Ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) chicken livers; 3 slices bacon; 4 tbsp butter; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving the drippings:. Add butter to the bacon fat and melt. Sauté chicken livers in the hot fat ~3 minutes per side until just cooked through (slightly pink inside is okay):. Transfer livers, bacon, and all fat to a food processor. Add salt and blend until very smooth:. Pour into a dish and chill until firm. Serve cold, spread on slices of cold cooked meat or eat with a spoon for a rich snack.

Title: Slow-Cooked Pork Ribs
Ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) pork ribs (spare ribs or baby back); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Season the pork ribs all over with salt. Place ribs in a slow cooker (cut into sections if needed to fit) and cook on LOW ~6 hours until very tender:. For a crispy finish, transfer ribs to a baking sheet and broil in the oven ~5 minutes to brown the top:. Let rest a few minutes. Cut into individual ribs and serve warm with some of the rendered juices spooned over.

Title: Homemade Breakfast Sausage Patties
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground pork (fattier is better); 1 tsp salt; (optional: 1/2 tsp dried sage)
Instructions: In a bowl, combine ground pork and salt (add sage if using) until just mixed (do not overwork). Form into small flat patties (about 8 patties from 1 lb):. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Fry sausage patties ~3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through:. Drain excess fat if needed. Serve hot. *(For strict carnivore, omit herbs and use just pork and salt.)*

Title: Bacon Chips
Ingredients: 6 slices bacon
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut bacon slices into bite-size pieces or 2-inch strips and lay them flat on the sheet without overlapping:. Bake ~10–15 minutes until bacon is deep golden and crispy:. Remove from oven and transfer bacon pieces to paper towels to drain excess grease. Let cool to crisp up fully. Enjoy these bacon chips on their own or as dippers.

Title: Pepperoni Chips
Ingredients: 20–24 slices pepperoni
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lay pepperoni slices in a single layer on the sheet (they can be close but not overlapping):. Bake ~7–9 minutes until pepperoni is starting to crisp and lots of fat has rendered out:. Blot excess grease with paper towels, then let the chips cool on the sheet until fully crisp. These spicy, crunchy pepperoni chips are a satisfying dirty-carnivore snack.

Title: Steak and Eggs Breakfast
Ingredients: 1 small steak (sirloin or ribeye, ~8 oz/225 g); 2 eggs; 1 tbsp butter (or tallow); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Let steak come to room temperature for even cooking (optional). Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season steak with salt and sear ~3–4 minutes per side or until cooked to your preferred doneness:. Remove steak and let it rest. In the same skillet, fry eggs in the remaining fat to desired doneness:. Serve the steak with fried eggs on top or on the side. Spoon any pan juices over the steak. A hearty morning meal!

Title: Carnivore Eggs Benedict
Ingredients: 2 eggs; 2 slices Canadian bacon or ham; 3 egg yolks (for sauce); 1/2 cup (120 ml) melted butter; (optional: 1 tsp lemon juice)
Instructions: In a skillet, sear the ham until lightly browned and heated through; set on serving plates. Poach the 2 whole eggs in simmering water with a dash of salt ~3–4 minutes until whites are set:. Meanwhile, make hollandaise: In a heatproof bowl, whisk egg yolks. Place over a pan of barely simmering water and slowly whisk in melted butter until thickened (do not scramble the yolks). Whisk in lemon juice off heat if using:. Remove poached eggs with a slotted spoon, let drip, and set each on a ham slice. Pour warm hollandaise over each egg. Serve immediately. *(Omit lemon for strict carnivore, and use sugar-free ham.)*

Title: Salmon Jerky
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) salmon fillet (skinless); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Slice salmon into thin strips (about 1/4 inch thick) along the grain. Pat strips dry and sprinkle with salt:. Arrange salmon strips on dehydrator trays (or on a wire rack over a baking sheet in a 160°F/70°C oven). Dry for ~4–5 hours until salmon is firm and mostly dry but slightly pliable:. Let cool and store in an airtight container. This chewy salmon jerky provides a protein-packed carnivore snack.

Title: Pan-Fried Halloumi Cheese
Ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) halloumi cheese, sliced into 1/3-inch thick pieces
Instructions: Pat halloumi slices dry. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat (no oil needed, or use a dab of butter). Place cheese slices in the hot pan:. Fry ~2 minutes per side until golden brown crust forms and the cheese is soft inside:. Remove from pan and serve immediately. These fried cheese slices are crispy on the outside and chewy inside—a satisfying savory snack.

Title: Cheese Shell Tacos
Ingredients: 2 cups shredded cheddar or provolone cheese; 1 lb (450 g) ground beef; 1 tsp salt; (optional: 1/2 tsp chili powder)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment. Make 4 cheese circles (about 1/2 cup each) on the sheet, spaced apart. Bake ~5–7 minutes until cheese fully melts and turns slightly golden:. Remove and let cool 1 minute, then lift each cheese round and drape over a thick handle or foil-lined rod to form a taco shell shape:. In a skillet, brown ground beef with salt (and chili if using) until cooked:. Fill cooled cheese shells with the seasoned beef. Enjoy these all-cheese taco shells stuffed with juicy meat. *(Skip spices for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Beef and Bacon Skewers
Ingredients: 1.5 lbs (680 g) beef sirloin or ribeye, cut into 1-inch cubes; 8 slices bacon, cut into thirds; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread beef cubes onto skewers, weaving or wrapping a piece of bacon around each cube:. Season skewers all over with salt. Grill skewers ~3–4 minutes per side, grilling each of the four sides until beef is seared and bacon is crispy on the edges:. Remove from grill and let rest 5 minutes. Slide meat and bacon off skewers and serve hot.

Title: Carnivore Beef Stroganoff
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) beef chuck or steak, sliced thin; 4 tbsp butter; 1 cup heavy cream; 1 tsp salt; (optional: 1/4 onion, finely chopped)
Instructions: In a skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. (If using onion, sauté it in the butter until translucent:.) Add beef slices and brown ~2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally:. Pour in heavy cream and salt. Reduce heat to low and simmer ~20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until beef is tender and sauce thickens:. Serve the stroganoff in bowls. The rich creamy sauce coats the tender beef for a satisfying carnivore meal. *(Omit onion for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Carnivore Meatza (Meat-Crust Pizza)
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef; 1 egg; 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese; 2 oz (60 g) pepperoni slices; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a bowl, mix ground beef with egg and salt. Spread the mixture out into a thin even circle (or rectangle) on a parchment-lined baking sheet to form a crust:. Bake ~10 minutes until the meat crust is mostly cooked. Drain excess grease:. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the crust and top with pepperoni slices:. Return to oven and bake ~8–10 more minutes until cheese is melted and slightly browned:. Let cool a few minutes, then slice and serve. *(For strict carnivore, skip pepperoni/cheese and just enjoy the baked meat crust.)*

Title: Carnivore Clam Chowder
Ingredients: 2 cups chopped clams (fresh or canned, drained); 4 slices bacon, diced; 2 cups heavy cream; 1 cup clam juice or bone broth; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon bits and set aside, leaving the fat in the pan:. Add clams to the bacon fat and sauté ~1–2 minutes (if using raw clams, cook until just firm):. Pour in heavy cream, clam juice, and salt. Simmer on low heat ~10 minutes, stirring occasionally, to let flavors combine:. Stir crispy bacon back in just before serving. Ladle into bowls and enjoy this hearty, all-animal chowder.

Title: Bacon-Wrapped Meatball Bites
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef; 1 egg; 8 slices thin bacon (cut in half); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat air fryer to 370°F (190°C). In a bowl, mix ground beef, egg, and salt. Form into 16 small meatballs (~1 inch diameter). Wrap each meatball with a half-slice of bacon, stretching bacon to overlap slightly:. Secure with a toothpick if needed. Place bacon-wrapped meatballs in air fryer basket in a single layer. Air-fry ~12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until bacon is crisp and meatballs are cooked through:. Serve hot, removing toothpicks before eating.

Title: Duck Confit
Ingredients: 4 duck legs (with thighs attached, ~2.5 lbs total); 1 tbsp salt; 2 cups duck fat (or tallow)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 225°F (110°C). Pat duck legs dry and rub all over with salt. Arrange legs in a single layer in a deep baking dish and pour melted duck fat over them (legs should be mostly submerged):. Cover the dish with foil. Bake ~4 hours until duck meat is extremely tender:. Carefully remove legs from the fat (they will be very delicate). Before serving, you can crisp the skin by searing the legs skin-side down in a hot skillet ~2–3 minutes:. Serve duck confit warm. (Strain and save the leftover duck fat for future use.)

Title: Carnivore Chicken Alfredo
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) chicken thighs or breast, cut into bite-size pieces; 4 tbsp butter; 1 cup heavy cream; 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook ~5–7 minutes until browned and cooked through:. Pour in heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Stir in Parmesan cheese and salt, reducing heat to low. Simmer ~3–5 minutes, stirring, until sauce thickens and coats the chicken:. Serve hot. The tender chicken is smothered in a rich, cheesy Alfredo sauce. *(For strict carnivore, you may omit the Parmesan and enjoy a butter cream sauce.)*

Title: Bacon-Wrapped Turkey Breast
Ingredients: 1 whole turkey breast (boneless, ~2 lbs/900 g); 8 strips bacon; 2 tsp salt; 2 tbsp butter
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Season turkey breast all over with salt. Wrap bacon strips around the breast, slightly overlapping, until covered:. Place turkey in a roasting pan and dot the top with butter. Roast ~50–60 minutes, basting once or twice with pan drippings, until turkey is cooked through (165°F internal) and bacon is crisp:. Let rest 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with any buttery pan juices spooned over top.

Title: Grilled Bison Steak
Ingredients: 1 bison ribeye or strip steak (~10 oz/280 g); 2 tsp tallow (melted); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. Brush the bison steak with melted tallow and season with salt. Grill ~3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare (bison can overcook quickly due to lower fat):. For cross-hatch marks, give the steak a quarter turn halfway through each side:. Remove from grill and let rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve. Bison is leaner than beef, so the added tallow helps keep it juicy.

Title: Pork Rind Scotch Eggs
Ingredients: 4 eggs (soft or hard-boiled); 1 lb (450 g) ground pork; 1 cup crushed pork rinds; 1 tsp salt; 1 egg (beaten, for breading)
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Peel the boiled eggs. In a bowl, mix ground pork with salt and divide into 4 equal portions. Flatten each portion into a patty and wrap around a boiled egg, sealing completely:. Dip each meat-wrapped egg in beaten egg, then roll in crushed pork rinds to coat:. Place on a baking sheet and bake ~25–30 minutes until the sausage is cooked through and pork rind crust is golden:. Let cool a few minutes, then slice or eat whole. Enjoy these hearty Scotch eggs warm or cold.

Title: Roast Prime Rib
Ingredients: 1 prime rib roast (bone-in rib roast, ~5 lbs/2.3 kg); 2 tbsp salt; (optional: 5 cloves garlic, fresh rosemary)
Instructions: Remove prime rib from fridge 1 hour before cooking to come to room temp. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Pat roast dry and rub salt all over (insert garlic slivers into meat and rub with rosemary if using):. Place roast fat-side up in a roasting pan. Roast 15 minutes at 450°F, then reduce to 300°F (150°C) and cook ~1.5–2 hours (about 15–18 minutes per pound) until internal reaches 130°F (54°C) for medium-rare:. Remove from oven, tent with foil, and rest 20 minutes. Carve the roast and serve slices with the pan drippings. *(Omit garlic/herbs for strict carnivore.)*

Title: Chicken Bacon Salad (Cold)
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) chicken breast; 4 slices bacon; 2 oz (60 g) cream cheese (softened); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Place chicken breast in a pot and cover with water. Add salt and bring to a boil, then simmer ~12–15 minutes until cooked through. Remove and cool slightly, then chop or shred the chicken:. Cook bacon in a pan until crispy; crumble it. In a bowl, combine shredded chicken with cream cheese until creamy. Fold in bacon crumbles:. Chill for 30 minutes if you prefer it cold. Serve as a hearty chicken salad you can eat with a spoon. (All ingredients are animal-based.)

Title: Meat Aspic
Ingredients: 3 lbs (1.4 kg) beef bones (knuckle, shank, etc.); 1 lb (450 g) beef meat (stew meat or shank); 2 tsp salt; (optional: 1 packet gelatin powder, if needed)
Instructions: In a large pot, combine beef bones, meat, salt, and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a very low simmer. Simmer ~12 hours, skimming foam, until broth is rich and meat is falling apart:. Remove bones; shred the meat. If broth is not very gelatinous, stir in gelatin powder while broth is hot:. Pour meat and broth into a shallow dish. Chill in the refrigerator until it sets into a firm gel (aspic):. Cut into squares or scoop to serve cold. This savory meat jelly is rich in collagen and nutrients.

Title: Spicy Beef Chili (No Beans)
Ingredients: 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef; 4 slices bacon, chopped; 2 cups beef bone broth; 2 tsp salt; 2 tbsp chili powder; 1 tsp paprika; 1 tsp cumin
Instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, cook chopped bacon until fat renders. Add ground beef and cook until browned:. Drain excess fat if desired. Stir in bone broth, salt, chili powder, paprika, and cumin:. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered ~1.5–2 hours, stirring occasionally, until liquid reduces and chili thickens to your liking:. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot. *(For a strict carnivore version, omit all spices—this becomes a simple meat stew.)*

Title: Sugar-Free Eggnog
Ingredients: 2 eggs; 1 cup heavy whipping cream; 2 tbsp erythritol sweetener (optional); 1/2 tsp vanilla extract (optional); pinch of ground nutmeg (optional)
Instructions: In a blender, combine eggs, heavy cream, and sweetener (if using). Blend on high until smooth and slightly frothy:. Add vanilla and a tiny pinch of nutmeg, blending briefly to mix (omit these for strict carnivore):. Chill the mixture in the refrigerator or pour over ice. Serve cold in a glass. This eggnog is thick, creamy, and indulgent despite having no sugar. *(Omit sweetener and spices for a strictly carnivore-friendly version.)*

Title: Broiled Lobster Tails
Ingredients: 2 lobster tails (~6 oz each); 4 tbsp butter (melted); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat broiler on high. Using kitchen shears, cut down the top shell of each lobster tail and split the shell open slightly to expose the meat. Pull the meat upward, resting it on the top of the shell (piggyback style). Brush lobster meat generously with melted butter and sprinkle with salt:. Place tails on a baking sheet and broil ~6–10 minutes (distance from broiler depends on size) until meat is opaque and edges are lightly browned:. Serve hot drizzled with any remaining melted butter.

Title: Salmon Skin Crisps
Ingredients: Skin from 2 salmon fillets (scaled); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Scrape off excess fat from the salmon skin (if any) and pat skins very dry. Cut skins into large pieces and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet, skin side down:. Sprinkle with salt. Bake ~12–15 minutes until the skins are browned, crisp, and starting to curl:. Remove and let cool on a rack. The skins will become crunchier as they cool. Enjoy these omega-3 rich crispy salmon skin chips.

Title: Bacon Bun Burger
Ingredients: 1/2 lb (225 g) ground beef; 4 slices bacon; 1 egg; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Weave bacon slices into a 2x2 strip mat (make 2 mats). Place on a baking sheet and bake ~10–12 minutes until bacon is cooked and somewhat crisp but still pliable:. Meanwhile, form ground beef into a patty and season with salt. Pan-fry or grill burger ~3–4 minutes per side until cooked to your liking:. Place the cooked burger patty between the two bacon weaves as buns. If desired, add a fried egg on top of the burger before closing with the bacon bun. Enjoy this all-meat burger with bacon for buns!

Title: Rabbit Stew with Bacon
Ingredients: 1 rabbit (cut into pieces, ~2.5 lbs/1.1 kg); 6 slices bacon, chopped; 4 cups water or bone broth; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: In a heavy pot or Dutch oven, cook bacon over medium heat until fat is rendered. Remove bacon bits and set aside, leaving the grease:. Brown rabbit pieces in the bacon fat on all sides (~5 minutes):. Add water or bone broth and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer and cover. Braise ~1.5–2 hours until rabbit meat is very tender and falling off the bone:. Stir bacon back in at the end. Serve the stew hot, with pieces of rabbit and a spoonful of the rich broth in each serving.

Title: Broiled Oysters with Bacon
Ingredients: 12 fresh oysters (shucked on the half-shell); 3 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled; 4 tbsp butter (softened); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange the shucked oysters on a baking sheet (use crumpled foil or salt to stabilize them). In a bowl, mix softened butter with salt and most of the crumbled bacon:. Spoon a dollop of bacon-butter onto each oyster. Broil ~5 minutes, just until the butter is bubbling and oysters plump up (do not overcook):. Remove and top with remaining bacon bits. Allow to cool slightly and enjoy warm, buttery oysters straight from the shells.

Title: Fried Chicken Gizzards
Ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) chicken gizzards; 2 cups beef tallow or lard (for frying); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Place gizzards in a pot, cover with water, add 1 tsp salt, and simmer ~30 minutes to tenderize:. Drain and pat dry. Heat tallow in a deep skillet to 350°F (175°C). Season gizzards with remaining salt. Carefully add gizzards to hot fat and fry ~5–7 minutes until browned and crispy on the outside:. Remove and drain on paper towels. Serve hot. The gizzards will be chewy and crispy—a flavorful carnivore snack for those who enjoy offal.

Title: Chicken-Fried Steak
Ingredients: 2 thin-cut beef steaks (cube steak or sirloin, ~12 oz/340 g total); 2 eggs; 1 cup crushed pork rinds; 4 tbsp beef tallow (or butter); 1/2 cup heavy cream; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Pound the steaks to about 1/4-inch thickness if not already tenderized. Place beaten eggs in one bowl and crushed pork rinds in another. Season steaks with salt, then dip each in egg and press into pork rinds to coat:. Heat tallow in a skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the coated steaks ~3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through:. Remove steaks. Lower heat and add heavy cream to the skillet, stirring to scrape up browned bits and thicken into a simple cream gravy:. Serve the fried steaks topped with the warm gravy.

Title: Carnivore Breakfast Burrito
Ingredients: 3 eggs; 3 slices bacon; 1 tbsp butter; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: In a bowl, beat 2 of the eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat with a bit of butter. Pour in the beaten eggs to form a thin omelette “wrap.” Cook ~1–2 minutes until just set, then carefully slide onto a plate:. In the same skillet, fry bacon until crispy. Remove bacon and chop. Scramble the remaining egg in the bacon drippings:. To assemble, place bacon pieces and scrambled egg on one end of the omelette wrap. Roll it up tightly into a burrito:. Serve immediately. (You can secure with a toothpick if needed.)

Title: Grilled Halibut with Lemon Butter
Ingredients: 2 halibut fillets (~6 oz/170 g each); 3 tbsp butter (melted); 2 tsp salt; 1 tbsp lemon juice (optional)
Instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high and oil the grates lightly (use beef tallow on a paper towel). Pat halibut fillets dry and brush with melted butter. Season with salt and drizzle lemon juice over (if using):. Grill fillets ~3–4 minutes per side until fish is opaque and flakes easily:. Remove from grill and pour any remaining melted butter over the top. Serve immediately, with a squeeze of fresh lemon if desired. *(Omit lemon for strict carnivore.)*
